description: PGP encrypt-and-sign / decrypt-and-verify pattern for partner file exchange: sftp/blob source -> pgp connector -> blob destination, as a single in-pipeline connector step rather than a separate encrypt/decrypt service.
notes: partnerPublicKey and privateKey are base64-encoded ASCII-armored OpenPGP keys.
All three PGP secrets must be Key Vault references in App Configuration. Connection strings and raw key material in plain env vars are not supported in production.

The pgp connector does not touch blob storage itself. It reads/writes the same base64 { content, contentEncoding } shape the sftp connector's download action produces, so it composes as sftp -> pgp -> azure_blob without a dedicated blob-read connector.
